title: Dora: When I Grow Up (demo pauses)
note: The real episode plays uncut. In demo mode only these moments pause, and Skip jumps over the non-interactive parts to `from`: a shot change a few seconds before the question, so its setup still plays. Times come from a Whisper transcript and ffmpeg shot detection of dora-ep3.mp4. `holdAt` moves a moment's pause a little later when the show's own pause frame hides what the kid must find.

exercises.label: Find the bridge
exercises.why: At the show's own pause (599.4 s) the painting bird stands in front of the bridge; by 600.9 s it has walked off, and the show's pointer only appears after 602 s.

exercises.label: Find the jewel
exercises.why: At the show's own pause (1194.7 s) the camera hasn't reached the jewel yet; by 1196.55 s it has panned onto the jewel on its pedestal, and the show's pointer only appears after 1198.5 s.
